connection_providers.title_he: חשבונות טלגרם — ספריית הסרטים של הלשכה
connection_providers.now: Nothing to paste here, and that is the point: a Telegram account is an INSTANCE of protocol `telegram_user` in the credential plane, holding the api_id/api_hash pair and the MTProto session string. The connection is created by the app's own login wizard (scan a QR or type the code) and removed from its settings screen. The session string is a full login, so it lives here and ONLY here — the app holds no copy of it. The probe is the tv app's own /healthz, green exactly while the app that reads the library is up.
connection_providers.wizard: open טלגרם TV (/a/telegram-tv/) and connect: scan the QR with the phone, or enter the number and the code Telegram sends. The account appears in this catalog as telegram_user-<id>.
